summary: Verified Journey Watch Phase 3 build round (funnel instrumentation + signup UI fix + graph coverage fix + Journey Watch watchdog). Backend: 5/5 pytest cases passing against real preview API — graph-status now returns has_graph=true with numeric graph_node_count for all 8 seeded project_graphs docs (previously read from unwritten cto_projects fields, hence 0% coverage bug); notifications endpoint keeps the standard {available, notifications, unread_count} shape so Journey Watch rows will surface through the existing cockpit bell with zero frontend change. Backend logs show clean startup of the new supervised tasks: '[journey-watch] starting · interval=300s lookback=24h' and no unhandled tracebacks referencing services/journey_watch.py. Frontend: verified with a fresh 0-project signup (funnel-test-0827@aurem.dev) — NewUserWizard does NOT auto-open on /dashboard landing (Phase 1 fix), ConnectRepoBanner renders first with the value headline 'Connect a repo to unlock your free SEO fix' before any permission-ask modal, clicking data-testid=connect-repo-banner-cta opens the wizard (existing behavior preserved). No console errors from NotificationBell (bell is admin-only, not rendered for the non-admin test user, which is expected). GitHub OAuth completion path is blocked by sandbox (known dependency), not retested end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/main.py wires journey_watch_loop() and schedule_funnel_digest_cron() via existing _supervise pattern — clean, no new endpoints/collections as constrained.
services/journey_watch.py reuses health_notifications + health_check_state collections (correct — cockpit bell already polls /admin/status/notifications every ~12s). No schema drift risk.
admin_analytics.py /admin/graph-status now correctly joins project_graphs collection — previously read unwritten cto_projects.graph_built_at/graph_node_count fields which is why coverage showed 0%.

NewUserWizard.jsx footer duplicate-CTA fix is narrowly scoped to (ghStatus==='choosing' && !appPickerActive) branch — 'connected'/'manual'/appPickerActive branches still render the standard Footer with primary 'Continue' — no regression to existing states.
